checkpoint_selection: fixed dev20k question-macro F1 then accuracy
historical_fin_laya: separate full-data multi-stage system reference; not matched-budget control

accuracy.aggregation: Correct predictions divided by all 240458 common-test rows; row-weighted.
accuracy.invalid_predictions: Reported separately; invalid answers do not reduce the evaluation denominator.

question_macro_f1.per_question: Macro F1 over the full legal candidate set, with zero_division=0.

exposure_definitions.unique_training_rows: Distinct downstream input rows in the nested sample; not the number of repeated optimizer exposures.
exposure_definitions.selected_stage_row_exposures: Rows processed in this training stage up to the published checkpoint.
exposure_definitions.selected_cumulative_row_exposures: Selected-stage exposures plus the selected initialization checkpoint exposures where training is continued.
exposure_definitions.terminal_stage_row_exposures: Rows processed by this stage at termination; this is not necessarily the published checkpoint.

reference_scope: Historical full-data sharp-421m and upstream original Laya are separate system references; this table lists the 10 formal downstream-trained versions.

method_definitions.head_only: Freeze the official backbone; train the shared linear decision head.
method_definitions.lora: LoRA-SFT of the backbone together with the same decision-head architecture.
method_definitions.native_laya: Update the native Laya encoder and original decision head; SFT, additional RLCD, and continued-SFT stages retain separate labels.

comparison_scope.qwen4b_internal: Same upstream checkpoint and nested downstream row set; compare each 200k method best checkpoint on full dev, question-macro F1 first and accuracy second.
comparison_scope.qwen4b9b: Matched downstream rows; 4B-Base and 9B post-trained checkpoints differ in upstream training history as well as scale.
comparison_scope.laya_controls: Same downstream row IDs and observed labels, with the native Laya encoding and architecture.
comparison_scope.reported_exposures: Stage and cumulative checkpoint exposures accompany unique row budgets.
